title: Decision Practice
subtitle: Stop & Decide prompts to build active clinical judgment
howToUse: These decision points interrupt passive reading and force active thinking. For each scenario, pause and write your response. Then compare with the model response. Focus on (1) the immediate risk, (2) the safest first nursing action, and (3) what data you must check next.

decisions.title: Advance directive conflict
decisions.scenario: A patient has a valid advance directive declining life-sustaining treatment. Family members request that “everything possible” be done despite the documented wishes.
prompts: Your first action
Your reason (what risk are you preventing?)
What you will check next (one key assessment)

decisions.title: Mandatory reporting
decisions.scenario: During assessment, you observe signs that raise concern for possible elder abuse. The patient appears fearful and hesitant to answer questions.
prompts: Your first action
Your reason (what risk are you preventing?)
What you will check next (one key assessment)

decisions.title: Cultural sensitivity
decisions.scenario: A patient’s cultural beliefs conflict with the recommended medical treatment. The patient expresses discomfort and reluctance to proceed with the proposed plan of care.
prompts: Your first action
Your reason (what risk are you preventing?)
What you will check next (one key assessment)

decisions.title: Professional boundaries
decisions.scenario: A patient expresses gratitude by offering you an expensive personal gift, stating that you “deserve it for all your care.”
prompts: Your first action
Your reason (what risk are you preventing?)
What you will check next (one key assessment)

decisions.title: Social media use
decisions.scenario: A nurse posts a story on social media describing an interesting patient case, believing that omitting names and identifiers makes it acceptable.
prompts: Your first action
Your reason (what risk are you preventing?)
What you will check next (one key assessment)
decisions.modelFirst: Remove the post and report per policy.
